description: Build the remaining sections and finalize the site: filterable Gallery, Testimonials, accessible FAQ accordion, Visit/Contact section with final booking CTA, and Footer (dark sapphire navy). Then final responsiveness/accessibility polish and a rewritten README with local setup instructions and clear image/content-swap guidance. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Gallery (src/components/Gallery.tsx): id='gallery'. Eyebrow 'REAL RESULTS'; serif headline 'See the artistry.'. Filter controls: All, Lashes, Brows, Skin, PMU (buttons with aria-pressed reflecting active filter, keyboard accessible). Responsive image grid rendered from src/data/gallery.ts, filtered by active category ('All' shows everything). Subtle filtering transition (fade/opacity) that respects prefers-reduced-motion. Each image has descriptive alt and lazy loading (loading='lazy'). TODO comment for swapping in client images.

Testimonials (src/components/Testimonials.tsx): eyebrow 'KIND WORDS'; serif headline 'Trusted by our clients.'. Render 3 testimonial cards from src/data/testimonials.ts, each with an accessible star rating (e.g. aria-label 'Rated 5 out of 5 stars'), the quote, and a generic placeholder attribution (no fabricated named identities). Subtle card styling with thin borders.

FAQ (src/components/FAQ.tsx): id='faq'. Heading 'FAQ'; headline 'Before your appointment.'. Accessible accordion built from src/data/faq.ts: each item is a <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls targeting a region with a matching id; only the triggered panel toggles; keyboard operable (Enter/Space) and focus-visible states; use semantic markup (e.g. dl or headings + button). Answers direct users to GlossGenius for current pricing, availability, and policy details. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the expand animation.

ContactSection (src/components/ContactSection.tsx): id='contact' (also serve as the 'about'/visit anchor target; ensure an id='about' anchor exists somewhere sensible so the About nav link resolves - can be on ArtistsSection/About area or this section; make sure #about scrolls to meaningful content). Heading 'VISIT SAPPHIRE'; headline 'A beauty experience designed for you.'. Include a studio image (Unsplash, alt + TODO), location details '346 2nd Ave SW' / 'Cedar Rapids, Iowa', a booking availability link to BOOKING_URL, and a final CTA block: headline 'Your next appointment starts here.' with a 'BOOK AT SAPPHIRE' button opening BOOKING_URL in a new tab.

Footer (src/components/Footer.tsx): dark sapphire navy background (var(--navy)) with cream/white text and accessible contrast. Include 'Sapphire Beauty Studio', social placeholders (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok as links with href='#' or placeholder + TODO + aria-labels), grouped links (Booking -> BOOKING_URL, Policies -> BOOKING_URL, Contact -> #contact), and a dynamic current-year copyright using new Date().getFullYear().

Ensure the About nav link (#about) resolves to real content. If there is no dedicated About section, add a concise About band (studio story positioning Sapphire as one cohesive luxury destination with Colby as founder and Emi/Reegan as independent professionals) with id='about', or attach id='about' to the appropriate existing section - document the choice.

Final polish pass: verify full responsiveness at mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints (grids collapse, hero stacks, nav switches to hamburger), consistent spacing/whitespace, thin borders, subtle hover/transition only (no autoplay video, no popups, no cookie banner), keyboard navigation and visible focus states across all interactive elements, and image loading='lazy' where appropriate.

Rewrite README.md: project overview (Vite + React + TS marketing site for Sapphire Beauty Studio), prerequisites (Node 18+), local setup ('npm install' then 'npm run dev', note Vite default http://localhost:5173, 'npm run build' -> dist, 'npm run preview'), a note that dependencies must be installed locally because the build sandbox had no npm registry access, project structure overview, and a clearly-labeled 'Updating content later' section explaining where to swap stock images, testimonials, social links, artist details, and individual booking links (point to src/data/* files and constants.ts).

Wire Gallery, Testimonials, FAQ, ContactSection, Footer into src/App.tsx replacing FEAT-001 placeholders; ensure final section order and all anchor ids (home, services, artists, about, gallery, faq, contact) resolve.
acceptance_criteria: Gallery filters by All/Lashes/Brows/Skin/PMU, buttons expose active state (aria-pressed), grid updates correctly per filter with a subtle transition, and images lazy-load.
Testimonials shows 3 cards with accessible star ratings and generic (non-fabricated) attributions.
FAQ is a keyboard-accessible accordion using aria-expanded/aria-controls with the 5 specified questions; answers point users to GlossGenius for pricing/availability/policy.

ContactSection shows the exact heading, headline, address '346 2nd Ave SW / Cedar Rapids, Iowa', final CTA headline 'Your next appointment starts here.', and a 'BOOK AT SAPPHIRE' button to BOOKING_URL in a new tab.
Footer uses sapphire navy, includes brand name, Instagram/Facebook/TikTok placeholders, Booking/Policies/Contact links, and a dynamic current-year copyright.
Every nav anchor (home, services, artists, about, gallery, faq, contact) resolves to an existing section id; README documents local setup and content-swap locations.
verification: Read each new component and confirm exact spec strings are present verbatim.
grep for anchor ids and confirm each nav target id exists exactly once in the rendered tree.
grep 'glossgenius' across final CTAs (contact final CTA, footer booking) and confirm target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'.
Confirm FAQ buttons use aria-expanded + aria-controls and Testimonials ratings expose an accessible label; confirm Footer year uses new Date().getFullYear().
Read README and confirm it documents 'npm install && npm run dev', the local-install caveat, and where to swap images/testimonials/social/artist/booking data.
